editorial:
Imagine you and your brothers plan the perfect crime, but everything falls apart in seconds. That is exactly what happens here. You follow three siblings who thought they hit the jackpot with a big heist, but they end up in the crosshairs of a scary gangland boss. Instead of a real court, they are forced into a brutal trial run by criminals who do not play by the rules. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure as the brothers start to turn on each other just to survive the night.

What really works here is the acting. You can tell these brothers actually care about each other, which makes the betrayal hurt way more. The pacing is quick, though some of the middle scenes drag a bit. If you like crime stories with big twists, you will love this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gritty details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the sound design is amazing.
endingExplained: You find out that the youngest brother was actually working with the gang boss the whole time to save his own skin. In the final scene, he betrays his older brothers and takes all the stolen money for himself. The gang boss kills the two older siblings in a sudden ambush, leaving the youngest brother as the only survivor. He walks away rich, but he has to live with the fact that he murdered his own family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and shocking twists.
